_meta.source: Tax Code § 116, as amended by RA 11534 (CREATE law). The 3% rate is the standing rule; a temporary 1% rate applied during 2020-07-01 → 2023-06-30 as a COVID-recovery measure.

schema.periods: Each period applies for sales/receipts between its 'from' (inclusive) and 'to' (exclusive). The current/standing period has 'to': null.

notes: Applies to non-VAT-registered persons whose gross annual sales/receipts do not exceed ₱3,000,000.
Specific industries (e.g., banks, finance companies, common carriers, amusement, jai-alai) have their own §117-127 rates and are NOT covered by this table.
Pass `asOf` to the API to compute the rate that applied at a specific historical date.

periods.legal_basis: RA 11534 § 13 (CREATE law) — temporary reduction during COVID recovery
Tax Code § 116, reverted per RA 11534 sunset clause
